chain.title: Jennifer Dumped Me
chain.desc: Foliaaths ambush from jungle undergrowth and drop a Foliaath Seed.

chain.title: Raise Your Own Man-Eater
chain.desc: Planted in grass and fed meat every half-day, the seed grows into a tame Foliaath over two days.

chain.title: You Monster
chain.desc: Grottols are shy living-ore mobs that drop diamonds, and more if killed with Fortune.

chain.title: Taken Alive
chain.desc: Killing a Grottol with a Silk Touch pickaxe yields a Captured Grottol instead of loose diamonds.

chain.title: Just a Flesh Wound
chain.desc: The Ferrous Wroughtnaut sleeps behind a sealed door in its underground chamber and never leaves the room.

chain.title: Axe of a Thousand Metals
chain.desc: The Wroughtnaut's axe never breaks, sweeps a wide arc on right-click, and shockwaves the ground on sneak-right-click.

chain.title: The Iron Face
chain.desc: The Wrought Helm is the Wroughtnaut's second drop and is likewise unbreakable.

chain.title: Masks in the Savanna
chain.desc: Umvuthana guard the savanna groves and each drops the ceremonial mask it wears.

chain.title: Borrowed Rage
chain.desc: The Mask of Fury grants Strength while worn, one of six Umvuthana masks.

chain.title: Masquerade
chain.desc: Umvuthana Raptors ride into battle mounted and are the aggressive half of the grove's warband.

chain.title: Praise the Sun
chain.desc: Umvuthi, the Sunbird, presides over the grove from a raised throne and calls down solar attacks.

chain.title: The Sunbird's Face
chain.desc: Umvuthi's unbreakable mask summons a masked minion when you right-click while holding another Umvuthana mask.

chain.title: Heliomancer
chain.desc: Traded by Umvuthi, this grants the Sun's Blessing: Sunstrike, Solar Flare, Solar Beam and Supernova.

chain.title: Wingin' It
chain.desc: Nagas swoop from cliffside nests and drop a Naga Fang.

chain.title: Venom in the Back
chain.desc: A Naga Fang, iron and a stick make a dagger that poisons and deals double damage from behind.

chain.title: Quiet Death at Range
chain.desc: Bamboo and string make a fast-charging short-range blowgun that fires only Naga Fang darts.

chain.title: Rude Awakening
chain.desc: The Frostmaw hibernates in snowy peaks until its Ice Crystal is stolen or it is struck awake.

chain.title: The Stolen Shard
chain.desc: Hold right-click to channel an icy whirlwind; the crystal recharges while it sits in your inventory.

chain.title: Called Your Bluff
chain.desc: Bluffs are stone tricksters that drop a Bluff Rod on death.

chain.title: The Sculptor's Toll
chain.desc: The Bluff Rod repairs Geomancy gear and is the price of admission for Tongbi's challenge.

chain.title: You Must Believe
chain.desc: Completing the Sculptor's climbing test awards the gauntlet: lift boulders, tunnel through earth, ride pillars upward.

chain.title: Breaking the Master
chain.desc: Tongbi, the Sculptor, drops his staff and the full Geomancer outfit if you fight him instead of taking his test.

chain.title: Three Stones in Waiting
chain.desc: The Geomancer Staff spawns three small rocks that fire as projectiles after a short delay.

chain.title: Gibbous Gibbons
chain.desc: Elokosa Howlers lead their troop and drop the five lunar-phase paws.

notes: Verified against mowziesmobs-1.8.2.jar: only 55 ids appear both as assets/mowziesmobs/models/item/*.json and as item./block. lang keys, so the chain leans on kill steps. Drop claims come from data/mowziesmobs/loot_tables/entities/*.json (ferrous_wroughtnaut -> wrought_axe + wrought_helmet; sculptor -> sculptor_staff + the four geomancer pieces; sculptor_test -> earthrend_gauntlet; umvuthi -> sol_visage; the six umvuthana_<emotion> tables -> the matching mask; frostmaw -> ice_crystal; naga -> naga_fang; bluff -> bluff_rod; elokosa -> the five elokosa_paw_* items). IMPORTANT VERSION NOTE: this jar has no Barako and no Sunblocker. Barako was renamed and is present only as entity mowziesmobs:umvuthi ('Umvuthi, the Sunbird'), and the task brief's 'Sunblocker' item does not exist here - mowziesmobs:sunblock_staff is a leftover model with no lang key, so it was DROPPED and replaced by mowziesmobs:sol_visage, which is what umvuthi actually drops. OTHER IDS DROPPED (models with no lang key, so they fail set-membership): mowziesmobs:sunblock_staff, mowziesmobs:frostmaw_plushie, mowziesmobs:umvuthana_mask, mowziesmobs:elokosa_paw, mowziesmobs:elokosa_paw_closed, mowziesmobs:elokosa_paw_new_closed, mowziesmobs:logo, and the *_in_hand / *_frame / *_using render variants. mowziesmobs:barako and mowziesmobs:barakoa were dropped as entities - the jar registers umvuthana / umvuthi instead.
